notes.title: New Update!!!
notes.content:
New Update from the game. This Update includes:
[list]
[*] Major Optimization to every single object in the game.
[*] New Materials
[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]

Thank you for supporting the game.
For Any suggestions, please contact us.

notes.title: Second Major Update
notes.content:
Dear players,

Our second major update is going to be released on 28/Dec/2020

This update includes the following::

[list]
[*] A new map.
[*] A New boss.
[*] 4 new weapons.
[*] New weapon mechanics.
[*] Overall better performance.
[*] All maps updated.
[*] More bugs. ːsteamfacepalmː
[*] And smashed some bugs on my way by mistake. ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

For any suggestion or reports, please visit our webpage [url=http://masterdnim.com/gangdistrict/]MasterdniM[/url] 
or contact us at : contactus@masterdnim.com

Have fun and enjoy the game.

notes.title: Loading Screen, menus, and localization
notes.content:
Dear players,

In this small update we have:

[list]
[*] Added loading Screen
[*] Fixed a bug which game could crash when opening some maps using any other language than English.
[*] Addition feature to main menu and pause menu when playing "Sequence".
[*] Fixed a bug where some weapons don't spawn probably when they are far away from camera.
[*] A small modification on Colosseum map.
[/list]

In case of seeing a bug that hasn't been fixed please contact us at [url=https://twitter.com/GangDistrict]Twitter[/url]

Thank you for playing.
and have fun.

notes.title: First major update
notes.content:
Dear players,

Our first major update is going be release on Friday 14/Feb/2020

This update is including the following:

[list]
[*] 3 new weapons.
[*] 1 new boss weapon.
[*] 1 new map.
[*] New models for the bosses.
[*] New sound when becoming a boss.
[*] New effect for boss weapons.
[*] New fire mechanics.
[*] Secondary fire for some weapons.
[*] Dodge/roll.
[*] Update 2 old maps.
[*] Most probably we added more bugs? ːsteamfacepalmː
[*] And surely some bug fixes ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Hello there,

This is a small update that has the following:

[list]
[*] We have fixed some issues regarding the game and game play. 
[*] Improving the code so that it run smoother.
[*] We have added some new features for the bosses.
[*] When becoming a boss you loss all your remaining lives.
[*] Fixes on the easter eggs.
[*] General bug fixes.
[/list]

We are now working on adding new weapons, new features, new models and a new map.

Hope you are having fun.
